about: Bakshi & Leta works from Main Street in Williamsville and presents DWI defence and family law side by side. Sunil Bakshi is an Albany Law School graduate who its site says has practised DWI law for over twenty-five years, and Joseph Leta is a University at Buffalo law and business graduate.

51 reviews at 4.8, the highest rating of any firm here with more than fifty reviews. It explains seven stages of a matrimonial case and offers mediation as well as an uncontested route. It publishes a privacy policy and nothing else this directory looks for in a trust page, and no fee of any kind.
